Package edu.uky.cs.nil.sg

Interface GraphReader

All Superinterfaces:
AutoCloseable
All Known Implementing Classes:
ArchiveReader, DirectoryReader
public interface GraphReader extends AutoCloseable
An interface for reading a story graph from an input source. Though a story graph is segmented into "files," the source does not actually need to store the data in files as long as segments can be accessed via the setFile(String) method.
Author:
Stephen G. Ware

    • readNextLineAsCSV

      default String[] readNextLineAsCSV(int columns) throws IOException
      Reads the next line from the currently open file, separates the line where commas appear, unquotes each string, and returns them in an array of the given length, or throws an exception if the number of comma-separated strings does not match the expected number.
      Parameters:
      columns - the number of comma-separated string the line is expected to have
      Returns:
      an array of the strings that were separated by commas, with the commas and quotes removed and with escaped special characters replaced, or null if there are no more lines
      Throws:
